items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Chief Seattle spoke to the President of the United States... I’ve been to his grave there, with Iola.

ctx.x: Wonderful piece. Chief Seattle spoke to the President of the United States, to the Great Father in Washington. “How can you buy or sell the sky?” Because Washington wanted his land, all of Chief Seattle’s land. There was no way he could stop that from happening. But the speech is one of the greatest speeches on ecology. “Will you teach your children what we have taught our children if I sell you our land? Will you respect the trees, the water, the air, the animals, the fish?” Washington agreed to all of this. Put…
He gave the prayer to the four winds, and there was a blessing of the concert.
